name: Water of the Seers
summary: In Bloodhoof Village, young tauren drink the sacred Water of the Seers before their tribal trials. The draught opens the mind to the spirit world and summons a Plains Vision to guide them.

sections.title: A Vessel for the Spirit
sections.body: Young tauren drink the Water of the Seers before the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village. Tribal mystics prepare the draught for the ancient Rite of Vision. It opens the drinker’s spiritual sight, and the Plains Vision appears from the embers to guide the way to Seer Wiserunner.

faq.q: What happens after drinking the Water of the Seers?
aliases: what does water of the seers do
faq.answer: Drinking the Water of the Seers beside the tribal fire opens your spiritual senses. The Plains Vision appears from the flames to guide you across Mulgore.

faq.q: Where should the water be consumed?
aliases: where to drink water of the seers
faq.answer: Drink the Water of the Seers before the large tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village, just north of the shamanic elders.

faq.q: Who does the vision guide you to?
faq.answer: The Plains Vision guides you northwest into Mulgore’s foothills, to the cave where Seer Wiserunner awaits to interpret your journey.

angles.text: As a tauren, you drink the Water of the Seers as part of your passage into adulthood and your people’s sacred traditions.
As a shaman, the Water of the Seers gives you an early glimpse of communion with the spirit world.
